principles.name: System Stability Principle
principles.description: Continuous safe operation takes precedence over optimization or expansion.

principles.name: Evidence First Principle
principles.description: Unvalidated information cannot directly become Reality or a fact.

principles.name: Boundary Respect Principle
principles.description: A module cannot cross another module's authority boundary.

principles.name: Unknown Preservation Principle
principles.description: Unknown and uncertainty must remain explicit when evidence is insufficient.

principles.name: State Ownership Principle
principles.description: Each core state has one canonical owner and writer.

principles.name: Human Interaction Safety Principle
principles.description: Safety, privacy, and materially consequential interactions require cautious governance.
